meta_data.base_class: Book a <public transportation> trip for a user, including passenger details and payment method - refers to various public transport modes with reservable schedules.

user_id.description: The ID of the user making the <class> reservation.

reservation_no.description: The reservation number for the <class> the user wants to book.

cabin.description: The class or section for the booking.

password.description: The password of the user for authentication.

payment_method.description: The payment method to book the <class>.

baggage_count.description: The total number of checked baggage items.

seat_preference.description: The preferred seating arrangement for the <class> reservation, such as 'window', 'aisle', or 'any'.

special_assistance.description: Indicates if special assistance is required for the <class> reservation, such as wheelchair access or assistance for visually impaired travelers.

meal_preference.description: The meal preference for the <class> reservation, such as 'vegetarian', 'vegan', 'gluten-free', or 'no preference'.

travel_insurance.description: Specifies whether travel insurance is included with the <class> reservation.
